tasks.title: Repair the frozen-count guards a new enum value trips
tasks.description: R-5. A new ProductDomainEnum member breaks counted/frozen guards across packages. tasks.title: Mutation-verify the whole new suite
tasks.description: The spec's test plan says most assertions here are about an ABSENCE (no dialog, no banner, no checkout, no charge), which is the shape that passes for the wrong reason most easily. Systematically break each new behaviour one at a time and confirm the corresponding test fails. Commit the fix FIRST, then mutate, then revert — reverting an uncommitted mutation with `git checkout --` eats the fix, and a clean tree is the symptom, not the proof. Run one mutation at a time in this worktree.
